paper_facing_forward_social_movies.note: Paper uses eyes open + gaze near screen + steady face. Our app uses webcam attention ratio proxy.

paper_facing_forward_nonsocial_movies.note: Paper uses eyes open + gaze near screen + steady face. Our app uses webcam attention ratio proxy.

paper_gaze_percent_social.note: Paper uses gaze AOI to social half of screen. Our app estimates relative attention to social vs nonsocial video blocks.

paper_gaze_silhouette_score.note: Paper uses gaze clustering on person/toy AOIs. Our app uses inverse gaze variability as weak proxy.

paper_attention_to_speech.note: Paper uses gaze correlation with alternating conversation. Our app needs a dedicated speech-turn video task for this.

paper_response_to_name_delay.note: Paper calls name three times during movies and measures head-turn delay. Our app measures response time during name response task.

paper_response_to_name_proportion.note: Paper uses three examiner name calls. Our app currently has one response event.

paper_blink_rate_social_movies.note: Paper extracts blink rate during social movies. Our app extracts webcam blink rate during social video.

paper_blink_rate_nonsocial_movies.note: Paper extracts blink rate during nonsocial movies. Our app extracts webcam blink rate during nonsocial video.

paper_eyebrows_complexity_social_movies.note: Paper uses multiscale entropy of eyebrow landmarks. Our app does not yet calculate eyebrow dynamics complexity.

paper_eyebrows_complexity_nonsocial_movi.note: Paper uses multiscale entropy of eyebrow landmarks. Our app does not yet calculate eyebrow dynamics complexity.

paper_mouth_complexity_social_movies.note: Paper uses multiscale entropy of mouth landmarks. Our app uses smile/mouth score as proxy.

paper_mouth_complexity_nonsocial_movies.note: Paper uses multiscale entropy of mouth landmarks. Our app uses smile/mouth score as proxy.

paper_head_movement_social_movies.note: Paper uses head movement from facial landmark time series. Our app uses head position variability.

paper_head_movement_nonsocial_movies.note: Paper uses head movement from facial landmark time series. Our app uses head position variability.

paper_head_movement_complexity_social_mo.note: Paper uses multiscale entropy. Our app currently uses variability as a simple proxy.

paper_head_movement_complexity_nonsocial.note: Paper uses multiscale entropy. Our app currently uses variability as a simple proxy.

paper_head_movement_acceleration_social_.note: Paper computes derivative/acceleration of head movement. Our app does not yet store frame-wise head movement time series.

paper_head_movement_acceleration_nonsoci.note: Paper computes derivative/acceleration of head movement. Our app does not yet store frame-wise head movement time series.

paper_pop_the_bubbles_popping_rate.note: Paper uses popped bubbles over touches. Our app uses popped events over total game events.

paper_pop_the_bubbles_accuracy_std.note: Paper uses touch error standard deviation. Our app uses game motor irregularity proxy.

paper_pop_the_bubbles_average_touch_leng.note: Paper uses finger trajectory length on tablet. Our app must log mouse/touch movement path to compute this.

paper_pop_the_bubbles_average_applied_fo.note: Paper uses device touch force/kinetic data. Standard laptop mouse/webcam setup cannot measure real applied touch force.
